Welfare walks and a few tips
The desk is glad to help mid-morning
Pet Travel Notice

Travelers should review the companion animal rules before arrival so that check-in is smooth and your pet is protected throughout the journey.

Please keep your documents ready, use a secure carrier, and follow staff directions from the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways. <<FACT F065>> You should also allow extra care for rest, water, and gentle handling while staff confirm that each requirement has been met.

For larger animals, review the travel conditions well before departure and plan for a safe, calm process at the airport. <<FACT F075>> If your pet seems unwell, stressed, or unable to travel safely, speak with the desk at once so a better plan can be discussed.

For guidance on carrier checks, animal comfort, and boarding steps, please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
